author: Andrew Stalker
content:
What a lovely company to deal with. We had booked one of their bouncy castles back in April but due to strong winds and bad weather they immediately gave us the option of cancelling with full refund or booking for another date, we went for the later date.

Great communication leading up the day and they arrived a head of schedule to get things set up. The owners themselves were lovely and things were set up really quickly. The bouncy castle itself was in great condition, clean, looked new, and all the relevant safety features were put in place.

Do not hesitate to book with these guys.

Thanks again .
